churn_score_methodology: Hand-assigned demo scores from 0 to 100 based on the fictional signals listed per account. Not trained, calibrated, validated, or a probability; do not use for real customer decisions. For this demo only, scores >=70 identify illustrative high-risk retention rows and are not a validated threshold.

offer_policy_scenarios.positive_experience: After first value, mention 50% off paid plans for two months only if the participant explicitly indicates upgrade/pricing intent or a capacity need. Ask permission to share details; plan eligibility and terms are unverified.
offer_policy_scenarios.negative_experience: Acknowledge dissatisfaction, ask what was missing, and attempt service recovery first. For this demo only, rows scoring >=70 may then illustrate one free month as a hypothetical retention option; this threshold is synthetic and unvalidated. Do not promise eligibility or apply it.
offer_policy_scenarios.billing_status: No promotion, trial extension, credit, or billing change is connected or executed by this prototype.
